newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial to form bank holding company.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial to form bank holding company.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said on Monday it received permission from the Federal Reserve Board to form a bank holding company.

TCF said it received approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency last month to convert its federal savings bank subsidiaries in Minnesota, Illinois, Wisconsin and Michigan into national banks and to charter new national banks in Ohio and Colorado.
The company said it is still waiting for approval from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp for federal deposit insurance for the Ohio and Colorado banks.
TCF expects to complete the conversion to national bank charters next month.
The company's shares closed up 5/8 Monday at 43-3/8.
